family: Warm toy game show: wood blocks, soft marimba, glockenspiel bells, mellow brass and small coins on a wooden tray. Dry and close, every sound ends cleanly, nothing metallic-harsh, never a casino.

sounds.prompt: One single soft wooden click: a small toy wooden block tapped once with a felt-tipped mallet. Close-miked, dry, warm, mid-pitched, instant attack and very fast decay. Exactly one hit. No reverb, no echo, no metallic ring, no music, no voice.

One quick soft paper swish: a sheet of thick card sliding smoothly out of a sleeve. Warm, airy, gentle rise then a fast fade, a single movement. Close and dry. No crackle, no tearing, no crumpling, no reverb, no music, no voice.

Two quick separate soft marimba notes played one after the other, low note then a higher note a perfect fifth above, rising and cheerful, like a toy game-show button saying yes. Rounded wooden tone, each note short with a clean decay, the whole thing under half a second. Not a chord, no synth buzz, no reverb tail, no music bed, no voice.

One chunky toy coin dropping into a felt-lined wooden tray: a single mellow, low-pitched clink with one small bounce, rounded and warm, like a board-game token. No bright jingle, no sizzle, no spinning rattle, no other coins, no reverb, no music, no voice.

A crisp split-flap display clack immediately followed by one bright warm game-show bell ding on a glockenspiel, like a quiz show correct-answer chime. Mechanical flap then a single clear bell note ringing briefly and fading. Tight and dry. No reverb tail, no music, no crowd, no voice.

A short cheerful cascade of five chunky toy coins clattering one after another into a felt-lined wooden tray: mellow, low-pitched, rounded clinks with a soft brassy ring, quick and playful, a toy game-show payout. No bright jingle, no sizzle, no hiss, no slot machine, no casino jackpot bells, no music, no reverb, no voice.

One single muted clock tick: a soft wooden tock from a small desk clock. Dry, low-mid pitch, very short, rounded. Exactly one tick. No ticking sequence, no metallic click, no reverb, no music, no voice.

A short brass sting opening a TV game show: warm trumpets and trombone play two quick rising notes landing on a bright major chord stab, playful and confident, ending cleanly. Tight studio sound. No drums, no long reverb, no crowd, no voice.

A cheerful short fanfare hit for a game-show winner: warm brass plays a quick rising triplet into a bright major chord with a glockenspiel sparkle on top, playful and toy-like, ending cleanly. Tight studio sound. No slot machine, no coins, no crowd, no voice, no long reverb.

A gentle descending 'aww' tone: a soft muted trombone sliding down two notes, sympathetic and playful rather than sad, a cartoon game-show near miss. Warm and quiet, ends cleanly. No harsh buzzer, no crowd, no voice, no reverb tail.
A vintage toy cash register: a soft drawer click and one bright warm bell ding, cheerful and short. Close and dry. No coins jingling, no slot machine, no reverb tail, no music, no voice.
